appliesTo: PageSpec node.style (the only per-instance styling field; everything else is owned by the section contracts)

rawValueRestrictions.semanticColor: token reference only: no hex/rgb/hsl/named colours
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: token reference only: no px/rem/em/% values
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: token reference only: no family names

allowedPairsEvidence: pairs observed on the rendered site: paper cards and pills black on white, footer/bottom menu black on yellow, chapter index white on black (computed-1440 colour + background histograms; markup.txt classes)

fonts.generatedMode: font.text / font.display (Founders Grotesk, commercial, Klim Type Foundry) are allowed in a generated page only when the PageSpec declares fontLicence 'licensed-by-deployer'; otherwise use font.fallback-sans. The mirrored woff2 files are reference-only and never ship in generated output.
